name: StopComputeJob

parameters.help_en: The ID of the computing instance, excluding the region name
parameters.help_zh: 计算实例 ID，不含地域名
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the computing job
parameters.name: job_name

parameters.help_en:
The job stop strategy. Default value: `CANCEL` if omitted.

`CANCEL`: Stops the job directly and skips the current savepoint.
`STOP_WITH_SAVEPOINT`: Creates a savepoint and then stops the job.
`STOP_WITH_DRAIN`: Stops the job in drain mode and creates a savepoint, triggering the output of event time windows.

Strategies with savepoints apply only to running production jobs
parameters.help_zh:
作业停止策略。省略时默认为 `CANCEL`。

`CANCEL`：直接停止作业，跳过本次 Savepoint。
`STOP_WITH_SAVEPOINT`：创建 Savepoint 后停止作业。
`STOP_WITH_DRAIN`：以 Drain 模式停止并创建 Savepoint，触发事件时间窗口输出。

带 Savepoint 的策略仅适用于运行中的生产作业
parameters.name: stop_strategy

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
